title: DataResourceSpec
description: Declares a data resource to provision (logical only — no raw physical name, no raw credentials). Temporary resources (managed_ephemeral/pipeline_temp) REQUIRE ttl_seconds; persistent resources (managed_persistent/tenant_dedicated) REQUIRE owner + retention_class. A non-local provider REQUIRES a local_equivalent (offline golden path). Credentials are secret_ref/key_ref only.

provider.description: local (golden path) | a provider node id; non-local requires local_equivalent
